name: moss-ai-token-cost-tracker
description: Use this when the user wants to review or understand their organisation's OpenAI or Anthropic API usage and costs from connected accounts, or to set up, open, restart, or stop the Moss AI Spend Tracker dashboard. Opens the local dashboard, which retrieves usage and cost data for finance reporting; does not retrieve data into chat. Does not change provider settings or enforce spending limits. Do not use for ChatGPT or Claude subscription billing, or general model pricing questions.

interface.longDescription: AI Spend Tracker brings your organisation's OpenAI and Anthropic API usage and costs into one view for finance teams. Connect your provider accounts to understand AI spending without switching between dashboards. Built with love by Moss, the spend management platform.
defaultPrompt: Open the Moss AI Token Cost Tracker dashboard.
Set up the Moss dashboard so I can preview sample data.
Stop the Moss dashboard you started.

review.commerce_description: Free tool; no payments, purchases, or payment processing.
prompts: Open the Moss AI Token Cost Tracker dashboard.
Set up the Moss dashboard so I can preview sample data.
Stop the Moss dashboard you started.
Restart the Moss dashboard using the same saved connections.
Can you reduce my OpenAI spending limit?

publication.release_notes: Prepare the desktop-only directory listing with bundled Moss icons, support and privacy links, sample prompts, and clearer local execution requirements. Keep the existing dashboard workflows and persistent local state.
